name: ThankRedirect – Custom Thank You Pages for WooCommerce
author: Oxilab

sections.description:
🎯 A Powerful WooCommerce Thank You Page Redirect Plugin
📦 Redirect based on products, categories, user roles, payment methods and more!
💕 A plugin by Oxilab, built to help turn every order into a repeat sale!
⚡ Lightweight, works with any WordPress theme or page builder.

🎯 Features | 🎨 Templates | 🔥 Upgrade Pro | 📋 Documentation

What Does This Plugin Do?

Every time a customer completes a purchase in your WooCommerce store, they land on a simple “Thank You” page. By default, WooCommerce shows a plain order confirmation, and that’s it.

ThankRedirect changes that.

Instead of showing the same generic page to everyone, you can redirect each customer to a fully custom page based on:

  • What they bought: different page for different products or categories
  • Who they are: different page for wholesale customers vs retail (Pro)
  • How they paid: different page for PayPal, Stripe, bank transfer, etc. (Pro)
  • What variation they ordered: specific pages for product variations (Pro)

No coding skills required. If you can use a page builder like Elementor or Gutenberg, you can set up ThankRedirect in minutes.

Why Does the Thank You Page Matter?

The thank you page is the most underused page in any WooCommerce store. Think about it: the customer just made a purchase. They trust you. They are excited. This is the perfect moment to:

  • 📈 Increase sales: Offer a one-time discount, upsell a related product, or promote a bundle deal
  • 🤝 Build loyalty: Show a personal welcome message, a how-to video, or exclusive member content
  • 💬 Get reviews: Ask for a product review or testimonial while the excitement is fresh
  • 📢 Grow your audience: Invite them to follow you on social media or join your email list
  • 📊 Track conversions: Send accurate purchase data to Google Analytics or Facebook Pixel (Pro)

Most store owners leave all of this on the table. ThankRedirect helps you use it.

Free Features

Global Redirect
Set one custom thank you page for your entire store. Every customer who completes a purchase will be sent there instead of the default WooCommerce order confirmation.

Per-Product Redirect
Show a different thank you page depending on which product the customer bought. Perfect for upsells, product-specific instructions, or personalized offers.

Category-Based Redirect
Group your products into categories and redirect customers based on the category of their purchase.

Beautiful Ready-Made Templates
Not a designer? No problem. ThankRedirect comes with professionally designed templates for Elementor and Gutenberg. Install in one click and customize to match your brand.

Dynamic Shortcodes
Display live order information on your thank you page, like the customer’s name, order number, and items purchased, using simple shortcodes. No coding needed.

Works with Any Page Builder
ThankRedirect is fully compatible with Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, Beaver Builder, and all other major page builders.

Pro Features

Upgrade to ThankRedirect Pro to unlock advanced redirect rules and personalization tools:

Advanced Redirect Rules

  • User Role Redirects: Show a different thank you page to wholesale customers, members, or any other user role
  • Payment Method Redirects: Customize the experience for customers who paid with PayPal, Stripe, bank transfer, or any other gateway
  • Product Type & Tag Redirects: Create redirect rules for digital products, subscriptions, or any product tag
  • Product Variation Redirects: Target specific product variations, like size or color, with dedicated pages
  • Brand Redirects: Redirect based on product brand (works with WooCommerce Brands and YITH Brands)

URL Personalization
Automatically add order details to your thank you page URL, like the customer’s name, email, order total, or product names. Use these to personalize landing pages, pre-fill forms, or track conversions more accurately.

Analytics Integration
Accurately track WooCommerce purchases in Google Analytics (via dataLayer / GA4) and Facebook Pixel. Fires the purchase event with full order data: transaction ID, items, value, tax, shipping, and more.

Redirect Delay
Add a countdown before the redirect happens. Let customers see their order summary first, then smoothly send them to your custom thank you page after a few seconds.

All Pro Shortcodes
Access a complete library of shortcodes for displaying every detail of the order on your thank you page.

Shortcodes

Display live order information on your custom thank you pages using simple shortcodes.

Free Shortcodes:
* [wpkin_order_number]: The order number
* [wpkin_transaction_id]: The payment transaction ID
* [wpkin_order_status]: The current order status (e.g. Processing, Completed)
* [wpkin_order_created_date]: The date the order was placed
* [wpkin_customer_name]: The customer’s full name

Pro Shortcodes:
* [wpkin_order_details]: Complete order summary (items, customer info, billing address, and total in one shortcode)
* [wpkin_order_total]: The total amount paid
* [wpkin_tax] / [wpkin_shipping]: Tax and shipping costs
* [wpkin_coupon]: Coupon codes used in the order
* [wpkin_first_name] / [wpkin_customer_email]: Customer’s first name and email address
* [wpkin_billing_address] / [wpkin_shipping_address]: Full billing and shipping addresses
* [wpkin_items]: A list of all products in the order
* [wpkin_downloads]: Download links for digital products
* [wpkin_payment_method] / [wpkin_shipping_method]: Payment and shipping method names
* …and more!

Who Is This Plugin For?

ThankRedirect is built for anyone running a WooCommerce store who wants more from their post-purchase experience:

  • Store owners who want to increase repeat sales and average order value
  • Marketers who need accurate conversion tracking for ads and analytics
  • Agencies building custom shopping experiences for clients
  • Membership sites that need different post-purchase flows for different user roles
  • Digital product sellers who want to deliver downloads or access links on a custom page

Documentation and Support

For step-by-step setup guides, visit our Documentation.

If you need help, visit the WordPress.org support forum or contact the Oxilab support team.

Additional Information

Love ThankRedirect? Check out our other plugins at Oxilab.dev.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wc-thank-you-page directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to ThankRedirect in your WordPress dashboard to configure your settings.
  4. Set up your first redirect rule: global, per-product, or by category.
  5. Done! Your customers will now be redirected to your custom thank you page after every purchase.
sections.faq:
Will this work with my theme?

Yes. ThankRedirect works with any WordPress theme that supports WooCommerce. There is no theme dependency.

Do I need to know how to code?

No. ThankRedirect is designed for everyone, from beginners to advanced users. Everything is managed through a clean settings panel. No PHP, CSS, or JavaScript knowledge required.

Can I show a different thank you page for different products?

Yes! With the free version, you can set unique redirect pages for individual products and product categories. The Pro version adds even more rules based on user roles, payment methods, product tags, variations, and brands.

How do I show order details on my custom thank you page?

Use the built-in shortcodes. For example, add [wpkin_order_number] to your page and it will automatically display the customer’s order number. All shortcodes are listed in the plugin settings.

Will this slow down my website?

No. ThankRedirect is lightweight and loads only what it needs, only on the pages where it is needed. It has no impact on your store’s front-end performance.

Does it work with Elementor and Gutenberg?

Yes. ThankRedirect has a built-in template library inside both Elementor and Gutenberg. You can browse and import ready-made thank you page designs directly from the editor.

Does it work with WPML and multilingual plugins?

Yes. ThankRedirect is compatible with WPML and other popular multilingual plugins. You can set different redirect pages for different languages.

Can I track Google Analytics and Facebook Pixel conversions?

Yes, with ThankRedirect Pro. It pushes a complete purchase event to Google Analytics (GA4 via dataLayer) and Facebook Pixel with full order data: items, values, currency, and more.

What happens if no redirect rule matches an order?

The customer simply sees the default WooCommerce thank you page. ThankRedirect never interferes with orders: it only changes where the customer is sent after a successful purchase.

Can I use this plugin for free?

Yes! The free version includes global redirect, per-product redirect, category-based redirect, templates, and shortcodes. The Pro version unlocks advanced rules and analytics.
sections.changelog:
2.1.1

  • NEW: Getting Started now opens with a 90 second video that shows how to choose a default page, add rules for your products and show each customer their own order. Nothing loads from YouTube until you press play, and the player uses YouTube’s privacy enhanced mode.
  • TWEAK: The plugin page on WordPress.org now shows the same video.

2.1.0

  • NEW: New Settings page, separate from the redirect rules: your license (status, plan, expiry date and the masked key, with Activate, Change or Renew), Access, Tracking (analytics, URL personalization, redirect delay), Advanced (custom script, developer hook) and a Danger zone. Changes save automatically.
  • NEW: Access: choose whether Shop Managers can open Redirect Rules and Getting Started and change the rules. It stays Administrators only unless you change it, as before. The Settings page always stays with administrators.
  • NEW: Danger zone: choose to delete ThankRedirect’s rules and settings when the plugin is deleted (off by default, deactivating never removes anything), and reset all settings after typing reset to confirm.
  • SECURITY: Thank you pages now show order details (shortcodes and tracking) only to the people WooCommerce shows its own order page to: the logged in customer, or for a guest order the same browser, the first 10 minutes after checkout, or store staff. A forwarded or saved link shows nothing, and never the sample values.
  • SECURITY: Thank you pages opened with an order are no longer stored by page caches or CDNs, so one customer’s details can’t be shown to the next visitor.
  • SECURITY: The order key is only added to thank you pages on your own store. A custom URL on another site gets the order ID only.
  • SECURITY: Saving the redirect rules now ignores any setting the page doesn’t own.
  • SECURITY: Customer details placed in the custom tracking script are now escaped, so a name with quotes in it can’t run its own code on the thank you page.
  • SECURITY: Only administrators (users who can post unfiltered HTML) can change the custom tracking script; for anyone else the saved script is kept.
  • SECURITY: Order detail shortcodes now escape the text they print.
  • SECURITY: Custom redirect URLs must start with http or https: other addresses, such as javascript:, are removed when saving and are never followed.
  • SECURITY: The thank you page template library can now only be read by people who can edit content.
  • FIX: A custom thank you page URL on another site no longer sends customers to the WordPress admin when the redirect happens from the order received page.
  • FIX: Customers sent to a thank you page by a Variation or Brand rule now get the order details in the page address, like every other rule, so shortcodes and analytics work on that page.
  • FIX: Facebook Pixel now sends its standard Purchase event when the event name is left as purchase, so Facebook counts it as a purchase. The dataLayer event is unchanged.
  • FIX: Getting Started no longer lists features the plugin doesn’t have, shows the redirect delay correctly as a Pro feature, and explains that Pro needs only a license key, not a second plugin.
  • FIX: Saving the redirect rules no longer resets URL personalization, the analytics options and the redirect delay to their defaults.
  • FIX: Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel and the custom script now send each order once: reloading the thank you page, going back to it or opening the link again no longer counts the sale twice. Store staff opening a customer’s thank you page don’t send it either.
  • FIX: Failed and cancelled orders now stay on the WooCommerce order page, which tells the customer the payment didn’t go through and offers to pay again, instead of going to a thank you page.
  • FIX: A rule whose page was deleted, drafted or made private is now skipped, so the next matching rule or your default page is used instead of a page customers can’t open.
  • FIX: The transaction ID shortcode no longer shows a sample ID for orders that have no transaction ID.
  • FIX: The Install WooCommerce link in the notice now installs the right plugin.
  • TWEAK: Redesigned the Getting Started page in the same layout as Redirect Rules: a quick start checklist that shows what is already set up, a redirect flow chart of your own rules in the order they are checked, every check explained with an example, a guide to building your thank you page, questions and answers, what’s new, and a Free vs Pro comparison.
  • TWEAK: Category rules now explain that only categories set on the product itself count, and User role rules that guest orders skip them.
  • TWEAK: The old Settings page is now called Redirect Rules, and is redesigned to be easier to follow: a new plugin header shared by every ThankRedirect screen, a menu that lists every section with its status, an overview that explains how redirects work, rules written as plain sentences with an example for each, a searchable shortcode list, and a bar that appears when you have unsaved changes, with Discard.
  • TWEAK: When a field needs attention, saving now opens the section that holds it and scrolls to the field.
  • TWEAK: On the free plan, Pro sections now say they are a Pro feature and their controls stay locked, instead of saving settings that do nothing.
  • TWEAK: The custom tracking script now has a code editor with line numbers and syntax colors. Click an order detail to insert it at the cursor, or insert an example straight into the editor.
  • TWEAK: The custom analytics script now lists only the placeholders it fills in, and its example code uses them.
  • TWEAK: Redesigned the Account page to match the ThankRedirect settings screens, with the plugin header, clear cards for your license details, billing address and invoices, and a layout that works on phones.
  • TWEAK: The Account page now always shows the Payments card for licensed sites, with a clear message when the license is a free localhost license or was bought with a different account. The Billing card is shown only when the license belongs to the connected account, since it edits that account’s billing details.

2.0.5

  • TWEAK: Product and product variation dropdowns now show a clear loading indicator: “Loading more products…” appears at the bottom of the list while scrolling fetches the next batch, and “Searching products…” appears while a search is running.
  • TWEAK: The search indicator now appears the moment you start typing instead of after a short delay, so it is always obvious that results are being fetched.
  • TWEAK: The next batch of products now starts loading slightly before you reach the bottom of the list, making long product lists feel smoother to scroll.

2.0.4

  • FIX: Fixed product dropdowns not listing every product on large stores: the settings page was capped at 500 products, so anything beyond that limit never appeared in the “Redirect Per Product” list and could not be selected.
  • NEW: Product and product variation dropdowns now load on demand with server-side search and infinite scroll, so stores with thousands of products can find and select any product instantly.
  • NEW: Products can now be searched by SKU as well as by name.
  • TWEAK: Product variations are now searchable by their parent product name.
  • PERFORMANCE: Greatly reduced settings page load: the product list no longer runs one database query per product (previously 501 queries) and the settings payload is roughly 8x smaller.
  • FIX: Selected products that were later moved to draft or pending now keep showing their name instead of a bare numeric ID, preventing saved redirect rules from being lost when the settings are re-saved.

2.0.3

  • FIX: Fixed global redirect not working as WooCommerce default: the plugin now hooks into WooCommerce’s order-received URL generation at checkout time so payment gateways receive the correct return URL directly, with no redirect flash and full compatibility with all payment gateways and caching plugins.
  • NEW (PRO): Added [wpkin_order_details] shortcode, which displays a complete order summary including order info, customer details, billing address, items table, and order total in one shortcode.
  • NEW: Added “Upgrade to Pro” button with crown icon in the admin header. It links to the pricing page and is automatically hidden for Pro users.
  • FIX: Active tab now persists on page reload: the selected menu tab is saved in the URL hash so reloading the page returns to the same tab.
  • TWEAK: Left sidebar navigation is now sticky: the menu stays fixed while the page content scrolls.
  • FIX: Fixed nested sub-tabs (e.g. Basic Settings / Advanced / Developer inside Advanced Settings) breaking due to CSS specificity conflicts introduced by the sticky sidebar.
  • TWEAK: Applied Inter font consistently across all plugin pages and Ant Design components for a uniform look regardless of the active theme.

2.0.2

  • FIX: Improved redirect reliability: redirects now fire before page output to prevent conflicts with other plugins and themes.
  • FIX: Fixed delayed redirect JavaScript not rendering correctly.
  • FIX: Fixed REST API endpoints not working when WordPress is installed in a subdirectory.
  • TWEAK: Updated branding to Oxilab.

2.0.1

  • NEW: Added Elementor template library integration.
  • FIX: Fixed redirect issue.

2.0.0

  • NEW: Added dedicated settings page
  • NEW: Added Global Thank You Page Redirect
  • NEW: Added Per-Product Redirect
  • NEW: Added Product Category Redirect
  • NEW (PRO): User Role Based Redirects
  • NEW (PRO): Payment Method Based Redirects
  • NEW (PRO): Product Type Based Redirects
  • NEW (PRO): Product Tag Based Redirects
  • NEW (PRO): Product Brand Based Redirects
  • NEW (PRO): Product Variation Based Redirects
  • NEW (PRO): URL Personalization
  • NEW (PRO): eCommerce DataLayer for Analytics
  • NEW (PRO): Redirect Delay
  • NEW: Shortcodes (Free & Pro)

1.0.4

  • Tweak: Tested for compatibility with WordPress 6.8.
  • Fix: Resolved a per-product redirect issue.

1.0.3

  • Tweak: Tested for compatibility with WordPress 6.3.
  • Security: Added PHPCS and WPCS for improved code quality.

1.0.2

  • NEW: Added initial shortcode support.

1.0.1

  • NEW: Added a dashboard icon.
  • Tweak: Updated author URL.

1.0.0

  • Initial stable release.
